pages.text: Worn paths of earth and mossy stone run out from Firelink: north from the gate, south from behind the chapel, and east and west of the shrine. They lead to villages, towers, temples, taverns and graveyards, some of them a long way off.

Where a road forks, a $(l)signpost$() names what lies down the branch. At the end, another points the way home. Lanterns mark the way every fifty blocks or so; some have gone out.$(br2)The bridges are old. Mind the gaps.
